decisions: Only the sixteen active contracts and actual registers frozen at defa800 establish earlier teaching. Preserve the 2933 fixed nonregister artifacts, 134 archived files and every earlier register identity, analysis and milestone.

Assign all 82 original joint XII, XIII Exercises 37–43 items, preserving each English prompt, hint and source control. Exercise 37's global article/second-person-pronoun omission remains visible for its whole set. Third-person subjects in wishes remain permitted.

Assign the complete 252-word music-performance episode, Cook 174.7–175.17 (one-based PDF 190–191), with all 19 original notes and 20 anchors. English context supplies the preceding banquet and identifies the king's daughter. Subsequent love and gifts remain unassigned.

The complete nominal and verbal systems require literal displays, evidenced stems and endings, exceptions, basic uses and exact teaching scope. A bounded verbal system does not silently teach all other moods or lexical frames; a displayed abstract plural does not grant an unassigned count sense.

Use the attested masculine horn selection, separately evidenced weak noun hālga with hālgena, and the explicitly licensed endingless accusative cwēn. Distinguish documented alternatives from compliance with the selected exercise target.

Apply weak adjectives in direct address where required in Exercise 37. Cook's feminine plural -e and -a alternatives are both evidenced; the selected -a tables do not make all -e solutions ungrammatical.
Teach the descendants sense of sǣd and the husband sense of wer separately from their earlier headwords/forms. Explain the horn image contextually while retaining its literal wording.

Use Cook's selected onfōn dative frame in 39.6 and 40.8 with visible explanation. Other evidenced government must not be declared universally invalid. Preserve accepted/received into care as the meaning in 40.8.

Supply the full 144,000 exclusion phrase in 42.2 from the personally inspected Bosworth–Toller main page 1082 parallel. Declare acute-to-macron normalization and retain collective ðæt and final -o in ðūsendo. Make no general dative or unrestricted high-numeral claim.

Supply the complete love-fell-on expression in 42.1 with the evidenced long vowel. Select the singular knee in 42.8 without making plural cnēowu compulsory. Supply the semantic plural agreement after męnigu in 42.3 explicitly.
Use ne witon for 43.8; the reading's exact nāst remains separately supplied. The visible wǣre hint in 38.9 is explained locally rather than becoming an unrestricted comparative-subjunctive rule.
Keep swīgende and original note 12a, both note-17 anchors, both wynsumum forms, and the source's singular ungecnāwen wæs and ungewunelic. Explain these without silently regularizing the passage.

Reconcile the three independently prepared authorial reading translations: hēt fęccean is causative; hine refers to musical art; the audience thinks Apollonius is Apollo; wearð geworden is intransitive; final ǣlc is subject and him eallum are dative experiencers. Preserve the original witnesses and record refinements separately.

The 21 original practice tasks and four translated examples supplement the complete Cook sets. Tasks require meaningful changes of number, role, mood, clause relationship and interpretation. No additional connected narrative is composed.

Every actual input, model output, source hint, reading word and logical paradigm cell must have an exact form/sense/construction route and a learner-visible teaching or supplied-help location. Supplied material must not be tested as independent recall.

Fresh non-authors must independently solve all actual outputs and review every complete paradigm. Freeze the blind solutions unchanged in Git before unlocking the key and private audit. The current audit authors and coordinator cannot claim fresh blind independence.

After independent textual acceptance, create complete LuaLaTeX learner/key exports, verify full content parity, inspect every final page, integrate preserved registers, update README and project indexes, export Beads and save local Git checkpoints. Do not draft Unit 18.

Retain full-stem mægenes, mægene, mægena and mægenum, with the separately evidenced nominative/accusative plural mægnu. Preserve the withdrawn contraction proposal and its correction in the sealed source packet.

Assign all four singular cases of abstract andgiet. Plural count/faculty senses are outside this assignment; this is no claim that the noun lacks plurals. The earlier complete neuter class remains the foundation.
Explicitly teach the people senses of mihtig and ēaðmōd and the bounded personal-adjective frames of geong, eald, mihtig, ēaðmōd and rīce. An adjective table alone does not teach these uses.
The permission verb gelīefst has its own supplied homonym identity; preserve the actual earlier belief records. Verify all seven reading-token repairs in the final contract join.

Supply nīwne sang as one bounded phrase. Wright pages 49, 213 and 214 support quantity and the rule-derived masculine accusative; no claim of a separately attested nīwne token or inspected BT724 page is made.
Carry all eleven source-proposal identity mappings into the contract. For 73 Cook positions distinguish independent choice of inflection from a supplied lexical meaning.
